workshop.title: Leading from within
workshop.welcome: Welcome. This is your space to prepare, take part and continue the work after we meet.

pre_work.intro: Set aside ten quiet minutes. Watch the welcome and let the questions travel with you. There is nothing to submit.

video.title: Before we begin
video.description: Linn and Maria introduce the intention for the workshop and invite you to arrive with curiosity rather than perfect answers.

questions: When do you feel most grounded and effective at work?
What situations make it harder to act in line with what matters to you?
What does psychological safety look like in everyday behaviour?
What is one question you would like this workshop to help you explore?

live.intro: Use this page as the quiet backbone of the day: the agenda, your reflection prompts and the live group exercise in one place.

agenda.title: The inner conditions for sustainable performance
agenda.description: A participatory journey from awareness to concrete behaviour, connecting personal self-leadership with the culture around us.

items.title: Arrival and intention
items.detail: Connect, settle and frame the day.

items.title: Practice lab
items.detail: Explore useful responses to real work situations.

exercise.title: What helps people thrive?
exercise.description: Join the live word cloud when invited by the facilitators. Your response is submitted directly to Mentimeter.

post_work.intro: The workshop ends. The practice does not. Revisit the core ideas and choose a small action that can survive a busy week.

summary.title: The Seed and the Soil
summary.text: We strengthen the person and the system together. Skills such as awareness, flexibility and values-led action grow further when the workplace also offers clarity, safety and support.

resources.title: Seven-day experiment
resources.description: Turn one insight into a repeatable practice.

feedback.title: What should we keep, change or deepen?
feedback.description: Your feedback helps Inner Group improve the experience for future participants.
